pwa.readyDetails: This game is saved on your device. You can open it without an internet connection.
pwa.update: A fresh deck of updates is ready
pwa.updateDetails: Your saved players and cards will stay on this device.
pwa.updateAfterGame: An update is ready. Finish your game to install it.
pwa.error: Offline setup could not finish. Reconnect and reload before taking the game offline.
pwa.updateError: The update could not finish. Your current game is still available.
pwa.installDetails: Keep the game close. Add it to your home screen for quick access.
pwa.ios: On iPhone or iPad, open this page in Safari, choose Share, then Add to Home Screen and Open as Web App.
pwa.android: On Android, use your browser menu and choose Install app or Add to Home Screen.
pwa.desktop: Use your browser’s install option. On a Mac, Safari also offers File → Add to Dock. Firefox on Mac can play offline in a regular tab.
pwa.offline: You’re offline. The game stays at the table.
